attr.title: Alto's Adventure
attr.desc: Testing candidate 0.2.0-rc1: Android Alto 1.8.8 with offline controller adaptation. Verified only on RG35XX-H/KNULLI; other devices and CFWs need testing.
attr.inst: Copy your exact Alto 1.8.8 APK as altos-adventure-1-8-8.apk into ports/altosadventure, then launch Alto's Adventure. First launch verifies and installs everything automatically; no terminal or second script is needed. APK SHA-256: efb8eb2054e6c66173fc1638e6d005f048b48446b6029c4fdcb8aa8b9dcaaae0. Required game file SHA-256: efb8eb2054e6c66173fc1638e6d005f048b48446b6029c4fdcb8aa8b9dcaaae0.
attr.inst_md:
**Required game file:** `altos-adventure-1-8-8.apk`

**SHA-256:**
```text
efb8eb2054e6c66173fc1638e6d005f048b48446b6029c4fdcb8aa8b9dcaaae0
```

1. Download [altosadventure.zip](https://github.com/elarkitechto/rg35xxh-ports/releases/latest/download/altosadventure.zip) and extract it into **Ports**.
2. Copy `altos-adventure-1-8-8.apk` into `ports/altosadventure/`.
3. Launch **Alto’s Adventure** from Ports. First-run setup is automatic.

Keep the APK in that folder. When updating, replace the package files and keep your saves.
